description: Export a shareable bug-report bundle as one JSON object: the diagnose summary, the timeline (logs), captured screenshots, a HAR of network, and repro steps if provided. For just the network log use export_har; for a quick triage use diagnose.

app.description: Scope to one app/project (pane label or id; see pane_list). Omit for all.

windowMs.description: Only include events from the last N ms (default: the whole buffer).

name: export_bundle
